description: A warm, rustic bathroom vanity photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a centered symmetrical view of the vanity and mirror wall. The vanity surface below is a live-edge or thick-slab wood plank in a warm honey and amber tone, sitting on a dark metal frame. On the vanity countertop, a collection of amber glass apothecary bottles in various sizes forms a casual grouping, alongside a neatly folded white hand towel. A small ceramic or stone under-mount basin in white sits to the right of center, paired with a warm antique brass deck-mount faucet. Two small terracotta-potted succulents or cacti add a naturalistic note at right. The reflected view in the mirror reveals a bathtub or soaking tub in the background. Above the mirror, four directed round spot heads are mounted on a linear horizontal bar, angled downward to illuminate the vanity surface in focused warm beams. The palette is amber, dusty sand plaster, warm brown metal, and ivory — a deeply earthy and rustic California or French farmhouse character.
